PrincipalKind.description: What kind of subject a principal is.
PrincipalKind.title: PrincipalKind

description:
The verified identity behind a request, derived from the access token claims.

``account_id`` is the data boundary. Services must take the account id only from a verified
principal, never from a request body or query string.

account_id.description: Account (household or business) the token is scoped to (JWT `acc`). None for operator or service principals that are not bound to one account.
account_id.title: Account Id

auth_time.description: When the user last authenticated interactively (JWT `auth_time`, OIDC): a login or a step-up confirmation. None for API tokens, services and old sessions.
auth_time.title: Auth Time

permissions.description: Effective permission keys such as `mower.control` (coarse, token level). Object-level checks are answered by the authorization service.
permissions.title: Permissions

plan.description: Subscription plan key of the account.
plan.title: Plan

roles.description: Role names granted in the account.
roles.title: Roles

session_id.description: Login session (JWT `sid`); None for API tokens and service principals.
session_id.title: Session Id

title: Principal
